jobs.description:
We are Team possible – the people behind Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here! 
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.  
That means embracing technology and celebrating change. We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do  
Sounds like your kind of place? 

Your job 

The ITU Security Officer is responsible for defining, implementing and monitoring information security measures within the organization. Acting as a trusted security advisor, the role bridges technical teams, business stakeholders and security governance. He/she reports to the CoE lead des FSP architects & experts

Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to the information security strategy
• Identify, assess and manage security risks
• Ensure compliance with security policies, standards and regulations
• Support security incident handling and remediation activities
• Promote security awareness and communication
• Act as a central security point of contact
• Prepare clear and concise reporting for management
• Support audits and security governance activities
Communication & Leadership

• Translate complex technical topics into business-friendly language
• Influence and engage stakeholders across the organization
• Lead workshops, presentations and awareness sessions

Your profile

• Degree in IT, cybersecurity or equivalent experience
• Solid understanding of information security principles
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Strong analytical mindset and sense of responsibility
• Experience or interest in leadership and team management in the cybersecurity domain
Languages

• French : professional
• Dutch : professional
• English : fluent

As a Bus Diagnostic Technician, you’ll help lead the transition to smart, electric passenger transport. You’ll work in a modern workshop where you track down, analyze, and solve technical faults on buses from various brands. From day one, you play a crucial role in getting our vehicles back on the road quickly and safely.

On a typical workday, you analyze malfunctions using diagnostic equipment, read error codes, and interpret electrical diagrams. You carry out mechanical, electrical, and electronic repairs and maintain precise work administration. You support colleagues with complex problems, assist with roadside service during working hours, and continue to learn about new technologies such as electric drive systems.

Are you ready to further develop your technical expertise in a rapidly evolving sector? Apply today and discover a varied job where quality, teamwork, and innovation are key!

• Degree in automotive engineering, electromechanics, or equivalent through experience

• At least 2 years of experience as a diagnostic, bus, or truck technician

• Strong knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and electronics

• Experience with diagnostic equipment

• Valid driver's license B (D is a plus)

• Good command of Dutch or English

• Accurate, quality-oriented, and a real team player

• Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is a plus, but not required

• Technical mindset and eagerness to learn are essential

• Willingness for occasional roadside service during or outside working hours

• Service vehicle for business and private use (after 6 months)

Your responsibilities:

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Launched in 2017, 
mozzeno is a 100% Belgian digital lender that has established itself as a key player in the credit market.
 

Every day, we help individuals and businesses finance their projects through a simple, fast and fully digital process. Our strength? A unique blend of technology and human support, allowing us to deliver an efficient and personalised service.

In parallel, we give investors the opportunity to actively support the real economy in Belgium by financing the loans granted by mozzeno.
 

Based in 
Louvain-la-Neuve and currently experiencing strong growth, mozzeno is looking for an 
AI Automation Engineer to design, orchestrate and AI-augment our business processes.
 

Job content
 

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes — increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:
 
 

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell — scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation. 

• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify — our AI workflow platform — to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes. 

• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems — understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other. 

• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work. 

• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
 

• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience. 

• You are 
proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work — comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code. 

• You have a genuine interest in 
AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with 
Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as 
prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process. 

• You are comfortable 
integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end. 

• You are at ease in a 
cloud environment (Google, AWS). 

• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them. 

• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts. 

• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 

• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation. 

• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
• +10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Full JS Developer – Profile :

• You are a Dutch speaker with a good level of English
• You have strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST APIs, and HTML/CSS

Help build success in Tessenderlo as an experienced order picker at Kuehne+Nagel, working a two-shift schedule (early/late).

As an experienced order picker working shifts, you will ensure that every package in the exclusive toy department is assembled and shipped exactly according to the guidelines.

Our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions and verify whether you meet the job's minimum requirements. A consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have questions about this screening, please get in touch by applying for this vacancy or by contacting your nearest Randstad office.

Do you have experience in the logistics sector and are you ready for a new challenge? Call 011 54 92 85 or email talentcenter1@randstad.be!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of demonstrable experience as an order picker.
• Good command of spoken and written Dutch or English (necessary for safety instructions on the work floor).
• Physically strong, active, and flexible regarding overtime or weekend work.
• Able to commute independently to the site in Tessenderlo (not accessible by public transport).
• Willing to work a two-shift schedule (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM) on a long-term basis.
Your responsibilities as an order picker:

• Picking orders using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system.
• Carefully checking product codes and quantities.
• Packing and preparing orders for safe shipment.
• Assisting with inventory management and immediately reporting any discrepancies.
• Safely operating internal transport equipment (such as an electric pallet truck) and keeping the work area tidy.

Start as an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo!

As an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift, you will join the team handling the exclusive toy department at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo. During the night shift, you will oversee the accurate processing, quality control, and preparation for shipment of outgoing goods. Thanks to your logistics experience, night-time operations run smoothly, ensuring every order is ready for transport on time.

Our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions and verify that you meet the job's minimum requirements. A consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have questions about this screening process, please contact us by applying for this vacancy or by reaching out to your nearest Randstad office.

Ready to start a long-term role? Call 011 54 92 85 or email talentcenter1@randstad.be!

VG 458/BUOSAP

Who are we looking for?

• At least 6 months of experience as an order picker in a warehouse or distribution environment.
• Good command of Dutch or English to correctly follow safety and work instructions.
• Physically fit, energetic, and looking for a long-term position on a permanent night shift.
• Access to your own transport to reach the site in Tessenderlo independently (public transport is not an option).
Your responsibilities as an order picker:

• Picking orders using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system.
• Thoroughly checking product codes, quantities, and packaging quality.
• Carefully packing and preparing goods for shipment in accordance with strict guidelines.
• Monitoring stock levels and immediately reporting any discrepancies.
• Operating internal transport equipment (such as an electric pallet truck) and maintaining a safe, orderly work environment.

Are you looking for a job in 3 shifts?

Is Deinze easily accessible for you?

Do you have strong mechanical insight?

Read on quickly!

What does your day look like as a production operator 3 shifts?

 
• Grinding down the ends of the tubes
 
• Performing various quality checks
 
• Recording data in a MES system
 
• Removing residues
 
• Placing the tubes in crates and positioning them on the correct racks
 
• Reporting and documenting damage or deviations

You will do all this in 3 shifts:

 
• Early: 06:00 - 14:15
 
• Late: 14:00 - 22:15
 
• Night: 22:00 - 06:15

Your profile

 
• You have strong mechanical insight to understand technical drawings
 
• Working in 3 shifts is no problem for you
 
• Computers? You can work with them smoothly!
 
• You understand and speak Dutch and/or English well

Position summary:
 

You are responsible for leading the plant mechanical team (Shift Mechanical Engineers, Toolroom, Utility team, Workshop Team, Process Engineers) in all the maintenance and process activities in the plant to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of high speed can making Lines and ancillaries. You will be the key person driving operational excellence programs and size changes in the plant, and also be responsible for all the mechanical safety, lean events, capital projects, energy saving, and EIP.

What are we looking for?
 
 

• 7+ years relevant experience in maintenance in high-speed manufacturing with sound maintenance management practices. 

• Experience in mechanical power presses, hydraulic equipment maintenance, printing press, handling LPG, maintenance of gas-fired ovens, boilers etc. 

• Knowledge of AutoCAD - Mechanical. 

• Experienced in TPM implementation in process industry. Good understanding of other modern lean manufacture technique - SMED, Kaizen 5S, Structured Problem Solving, Six Sigma. 

• Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to prioritize workload based upon the plant requirements and KPI’s. Good planning skills, coordination skill and follow-up skill 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English

• You install and assemble sprinkler pipes according to plan.

• You correctly connect sprinkler systems.

• You perform inspections and pressure tests on the systems.

• You often work at heights, following the appropriate safety measures.

• You consult with colleagues on-site to work efficiently together.

• You ensure order, cleanliness, and safety in the workplace.

• Experience in a similar role is what you bring.

• A technical background or education is a must.

• Working at heights doesn’t scare you, and you do it safely.

• You speak and understand English well.

• A driver’s license B is required.

• Motivation and accuracy are what you work with.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone interested in cultural management, European cooperation, project work and the higher music education sector. The ideal candidate is curious, organised and comfortable working in an international environment, with a willingness to learn and take on a wide range of tasks. You will join a small and dynamic team working with a diverse network of institutions and experts across Europe.

 

 
 
As a Project and Membership Intern, you will support the day-to-day work of AEC and contribute to the organisation of events, projects and activities involving its European network. You will assist our expert working groups with organising meetings and preparing publications and reports.  Moreover, you will assist the AEC Office team with the overall management of the office and the various projects. This includes contributing to the financial administration of the projects, of AEC and of the membership. In addition, you will assist the team with projects and activities related to the green shift and sustainability.

Depending on the internship period you will have an opportunity to travel to AEC events to support the AEC team in event-related activities, such as:

• International Relations Coordinators (IRC) Meeting
• AEC Congress
• AEC Pop & Jazz Platform
• AEC European Platform for Artistic Research in Music (EPARM)
Ideal candidates:

• Interest in the higher music education and cultural sector at large
• Interest in the management and coordination aspects of higher music education
• Interest in the Green shift
• Comfortable working with a diverse network across Europe
• Seeking experience in working in a cultural organisation on a European level
Responsibilities:

• Support overall office and project administration, including financial aspects
• Support in coordinating European projects
• Support the coordination and administration of AEC projects
• Support the AEC team in its environmentally friendly actions and initiatives 
• Assist with membership-related administration, including follow-up with member institutions and support with membership fees and documentation
• Assist with the preparation and coordination of meetings with AEC members, the AEC Council, experts and project partners
• Support logistic activities for AEC events
• Assist  the AEC office team in preparing publications and reports,  support basic visual content creation (e.g. Canva)
Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Cultural Management or relevant field  
• Possess strong organisational and communication skills
• Willingness to learn
• Comfortable dealing with a wide range of tasks 
• B2 level or higher in written and spoken English (other languages are an asset)
• Good knowledge of MS Office tools, especially Excel and Word
• Ability  to adapt quickly to different situations, feel comfortable dealing with a wide range of tasks and with working in a team
• Proactive, structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to your work 
What AEC offers

• A remuneration of around 1.000 €/ month
• An opportunity to expand or gain a professional network in Brussels
• Opportunity to work with a small, dynamic, and international team in the cultural sector
• An internship contract based on the Belgian Convention d'immersion professionelle 
• A hands-on experience in a supportive learning environment

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you

will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects

according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on

you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love

to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to

learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies:

Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and

React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right

technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety.    

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.
